rows.headline: Braze posts 26% revenue growth, record cash flow
rows.sowhat: Customer engagement platform hits dual growth-and-leverage milestone, suggesting CX personalisation budgets remain protected even as SaaS spending tightens elsewhere.

rows.headline: RingCentral gains 176 G2 product badges across portfolio
rows.sowhat: RingCentral's strongest G2 season yet — 724 reports, 33 #1 rankings — suggests sustained customer satisfaction but tells buyers nothing about contract lock-in or migration readiness.

rows.headline: Tealium pitches governed AI context as CDP differentiator
rows.sowhat: Tealium's roadmap frames data governance as the new CDP battleground, but the real question is whether legacy integrations can actually deliver real-time consent updates to AI agents.

rows.headline: Snowflake raises FY 2027 guidance on AI consumption
rows.sowhat: Snowflake's Q2 beat and raised outlook turn on CoCo adoption and CoWork growth — signaling enterprise data workloads are shifting toward AI-specific consumption models.

rows.headline: CrowdStrike launches own AI models, agent security offering
rows.sowhat: CrowdStrike's Fal.Con 2026 push into proprietary models and agent security is defensible from the endpoint, but enterprises still need to map vendor AI sprawl before adding another model dependency.

rows.headline: Microsoft adds native app builder to Copilot Studio
rows.sowhat: Microsoft's Copilot Studio now builds native apps, lowering the barrier for teams that want agents but lack the development capacity — assuming they're already locked into the Microsoft stack.

rows.headline: Mistral raises €3bn Series D at undisclosed valuation
rows.sowhat: Mistral's €3bn raise cements Europe's largest AI funding round this cycle, but buyers need to watch how much of that capital translates to enterprise-grade inference reliability versus research prestige.

rows.headline: Qualcomm wins $60B AWS custom silicon deal
rows.sowhat: A multi-generation custom chip and 1.6T optics commitment with a $4B warrant locks Qualcomm into AWS's AI infrastructure roadmap and signals hyperscaler build-out intensity.

rows.headline: Genesys Xperience 2026 customers prioritise outcomes over orchestration
rows.sowhat: Customer presentations focused on measurable results provide a practical counterweight to Genesys's agentic orchestration messaging, signalling buyer scepticism about hype.

rows.headline: Twilio ships ConversationRelay with sub-0.5s latency
rows.sowhat: Low-latency voice infrastructure matters if conversational AI is moving beyond chatbots into real-time calls, but deployment scale remains unclear.

rows.headline: HPE issues Oracle equity warrant alongside AI infrastructure
rows.sowhat: HPE's use of a nominal-cost equity instrument instead of discounting suggests margin pressure in AI hardware and a scramble for long-term hyperscaler lock-in.

rows.headline: Gamma backs Epiris takeover, posts H1 growth
rows.sowhat: A UK UCaaS/CPaaS provider changing hands may shift channel dynamics and product roadmaps for enterprise buyers.

rows.headline: FNBO cuts financial crime review 50% with agentic AI
rows.sowhat: A deployed enterprise case quantifies agentic AI's operational impact beyond vendor promises, setting a benchmark for regulated contact-centre back-office use.

rows.headline: RingCentral positions multichannel versus omnichannel contact centres
rows.sowhat: Vendor educational content distinguishing multichannel from omnichannel suggests buyers still confused about fundamental architectural choices.

rows.headline: Salesforce embeds CRM data inside Claude AI
rows.sowhat: A hyperscaler-CRM integration bypassing traditional middleware could compress the marketing-tech stack but raises data-residency questions.

rows.headline: OPSWAT launches AI Content Inspector at GISEC
rows.sowhat: A new security layer for AI-generated content addresses semantic fraud missed by malware scans, relevant where contact centres ingest customer documents.

rows.headline: Arm extends physical-AI roadmap, links edge and cloud
rows.sowhat: Chip-architecture shifts toward edge AI may alter device economics for desk phones, room systems, and contact-centre agents' endpoints.

rows.headline: Observe.AI launches automated coaching agents for supervisors
rows.sowhat: Automates call-prep tasks and ties coaching directly to frontline metrics, reducing supervisor admin overhead.

rows.headline: 8×8 survey: CIOs accountable for AI failure, lack authority
rows.sowhat: 52% of tech leaders carry blame for AI agent mistakes but often lack governance infrastructure to prevent them.

rows.headline: Rightfiber forms after Ritter-Great Plains Communications merger completes
rows.sowhat: Creates one of the larger private fiber broadband operators, potentially reshaping US regional connectivity competition.

rows.headline: Cyara appoints new APAC GTM leader amid regional CX expansion
rows.sowhat: Signals intensifying investment in customer experience software across Asia-Pacific as AI adoption accelerates.

rows.headline: Genesys unveils four-layer agentic orchestration stack for Cloud
rows.sowhat: Aims to position Genesys Cloud as the enterprise system of record for AI-driven customer experience workflows.

rows.headline: VergeSense and Pointr partner on hybrid office planning data
rows.sowhat: Combines occupancy sensors with indoor location intel to help enterprises right-size hybrid workspace investments.

rows.headline: Qualtrics reports 51% of customers don't report problems
rows.sowhat: Silent churn means CX teams can't fix what they can't see — making satisfaction scores unreliable and retention harder.

rows.headline: McDonald's UK hires first Head of CRM, Loyalty
rows.sowhat: Calum Johns' appointment signals the fast-food giant is finally investing in owned-channel customer data and retention infrastructure.

rows.headline: Revenue teams claim AI use, 20% show ROI
rows.sowhat: A five-to-one gap between adoption and measurable results means most enterprise AI deployments remain theatre, not transformation.

rows.headline: Otter.ai faces privacy lawsuit over meeting data
rows.sowhat: Litigation risk around AI meeting transcription may force enterprise buyers to audit vendor data-handling and user-consent flows before rollout.

rows.headline: iQor reports 1.4M-call analytics case with unclear attribution
rows.sowhat: Vendor case studies that cannot isolate the analytics contribution from other variables offer little real decision support for buyers.

rows.headline: Sprinklr exec discusses AI-driven search changing customer journeys
rows.sowhat: Enterprise CX teams need visibility into how ChatGPT and similar tools now mediate brand discovery, comparison, and shortlisting outside owned channels.

rows.headline: Adobe names CX chief as CEO successor
rows.sowhat: After 18 years, Narayen's handover to the CX division head signals Adobe is betting enterprise growth lives in customer-experience platform integration, not creative tools alone.

rows.headline: Infobip lands Haidilao loyalty personalization deal
rows.sowhat: The hotpot chain's CPaaS deployment shows enterprise appetite for multi-channel customer-data orchestration when expanding loyalty programs across geographies.

rows.headline: Crexendo tops G2 rankings across UCaaS categories
rows.sowhat: Repeat G2 wins for a mid-tier UCaaS vendor suggest consistent delivery matters more than brand scale in SMB buyer decisions, though customer volume remains unclear.

rows.headline: Nokia tests network APIs for healthcare use
rows.sowhat: Nokia's BeeHealthy partnership targets a narrow vertical, testing whether telco-grade APIs can monetize outside core connectivity as enterprises explore edge-network dependencies.

rows.headline: No Jitter flags human oversight as 2026 theme
rows.sowhat: Vendor-authored trend summary linking agentic AI pricing to CCaaS-CRM convergence; no discrete product move or deal, but confirms ongoing integration pressure.

rows.headline: Adobe embeds 70+ creative tools into Slack
rows.sowhat: Teams can now generate and edit content via Slackbot, reducing context-switching but introducing yet another creative workflow fragmentation point.

rows.headline: Guidewire posts 19% ARR growth, AI driving cloud moves
rows.sowhat: Insurance insurers are now migrating to cloud for AI capabilities rather than legacy modernisation alone, validating AI as a buying catalyst.

rows.headline: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra catches 20% more bugs at 2.5× price
rows.sowhat: Improved cross-file reasoning may justify premium pricing for code review tooling, but unit economics remain opaque for most buyers.

rows.headline: Salesforce introduces executive deferred compensation plan
rows.sowhat: A routine compensation governance move with no strategic signal for buyers or platform direction.

days.label: Sat 05 Sep 2026

rows.headline: SoundHound closes LivePerson acquisition, names CFO
rows.sowhat: Voice and digital messaging AI consolidation signals enterprise bet on unified omnichannel agent platforms serving Fortune 100 at scale.

rows.headline: Adobe names customer experience chief as CEO
rows.sowhat: Eighteen-year CEO succession to CX division leader signals Adobe's strategic pivot toward customer experience orchestration over creative tools.

rows.headline: Optimizely retires DXP label for agent platform
rows.sowhat: Platform rebrand from DXP to agent platform reflects vendor repositioning as buyers prioritise AI governance over feature breadth.

rows.headline: HPE claims AI networks prevent CX failures
rows.sowhat: Networking revenue growth to $2.9BN suggests infrastructure vendors are capturing enterprise AI spend previously earmarked for application layers.

rows.headline: Sprinklr processes 180BN customer conversations annually via AI
rows.sowhat: Scale metric demonstrates enterprise-AI platforms are now operationalising conversational data at volumes that justify standalone AI infrastructure investment.

rows.headline: OpenAI agent hack makes AI governance concrete
rows.sowhat: Reported incident involving 1,200 agents communicating unauthorised converts abstract AI risk into immediate board-level compliance priority for CIOs.

rows.headline: Microsoft Teams adds QR code phishing protection
rows.sowhat: External-sender QR codes will be obscured by default, narrowing a phishing vector but adding friction to legitimate B2B workflows.

rows.headline: Salesforce bundles Agentforce, Slack, Tableau into editions
rows.sowhat: Consolidating AI, Slack, Tableau, and Premier Success into three SKUs may simplify buying but locks customers into a unified pricing model.

rows.headline: CompleteSMS addresses A2P messaging compliance burden
rows.sowhat: Growing carrier enforcement of A2P registration creates channel opportunity but raises operational complexity for SMB messaging buyers.

rows.headline: Commio launches FlexNumbers for simplified voice billing
rows.sowhat: Flexible local and toll-free plans target resellers seeking predictable per-number costs, but differentiation hinges on actual pricing transparency.

rows.headline: Adobe names Chakravarthy CEO amid AI transition
rows.sowhat: Leadership succession positions Adobe to capitalise on agentic AI and CX orchestration demand, but execution risk remains during the handover.

rows.headline: FIS launches Embedded Banking Platform for US banks
rows.sowhat: Banks can now embed financial services into partner software while retaining balance-sheet control, challenging BaaS disruptors on compliance grounds.

days.pattern_watch: Platform consolidation: Salesforce, FIS, and nCino all unifying fragmented capabilities into single SKUs or platforms.

rows.headline: Adobe names Anil Chakravarthy CEO
rows.sowhat: Adobe's CX business head becomes CEO, signalling customer experience orchestration is now Adobe's strategic centre.

rows.headline: Genesys unveils AI Control Plane at Xperience
rows.sowhat: Genesys positions itself as the orchestration layer coordinating AI agents, humans, data, and workflows across service journeys.

rows.headline: Anthropic drops data retention for enterprise models
rows.sowhat: Anthropic removes mandatory data retention after enterprise pushback, clearing a barrier to frontier-model adoption with sensitive data.

rows.headline: RingCentral replaces Mets legacy on-premises comms
rows.sowhat: New York Mets replace legacy on-prem with RingCentral cloud for internal and fan engagement—another premise exit.

rows.headline: Verint warns fragmented data threatens AI value
rows.sowhat: Verint's survey finds 87% plan higher AI spend, but fragmented data still blocks business value in contact centres.

rows.headline: Nvidia acquires Hugging Face for $12.93bn
rows.sowhat: Nvidia's Hugging Face buy signals a shift toward smaller, specialised AI models built for specific enterprise tasks.

rows.headline: Adobe names Chakravarthy CEO, Narayen to chair
rows.sowhat: Adobe's choice of its CX orchestration chief as CEO signals that customer experience will drive enterprise strategy, not just creative tools.

rows.headline: Bandwidth promotes Emily Harlan to General Counsel
rows.sowhat: Routine leadership succession as retiring GC Brandon Asbill hands over to internal counsel with no disclosed strategic shift.

rows.headline: TPx secures Chapter 11 approval, emerges with less debt
rows.sowhat: Court-approved reorganization clears TPx to exit bankruptcy with lower leverage and new ownership, enabling renewed investment in UCaaS/networking.

rows.headline: Phonely debuts Alma, voice-first LLM for call centres
rows.sowhat: Alma targets natural-language voice interactions in contact centres, competing with incumbent CCaaS vendors' embedded AI agents.

rows.headline: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Astra with cyber threshold trade-offs
rows.sowhat: Astra's monitorability gains come at a cyber-risk cost, forcing enterprises to weigh compliance overhead against model performance.

rows.headline: Genesys launches agentic orchestration layer for agents
rows.sowhat: Four new products govern multi-agent coordination in Genesys Cloud—a structural shift beyond standalone bots to orchestrated autonomy at contact-centre scale.

rows.headline: Sinch integrates email testing into Salesforce AgentExchange
rows.sowhat: Mailgun Inspect brings native preview capability to Salesforce Agentforce Marketing, reducing friction in multi-channel campaign testing workflows.

rows.headline: Numeracle releases KYCaaS to verify business identities
rows.sowhat: Corporate KYCaaS targets AI-facilitated fraud (projected $40B by 2027) with managed business identity verification—relevant for enterprises vetting partner ecosystems.

rows.headline: Webflow launches Source agentic workspace for marketers
rows.sowhat: Source gives marketing teams and AI agents governed, shared access to site code—Webflow's push beyond visual building into collaborative development.

rows.headline: Vodia adds CarPlay support to iOS app
rows.sowhat: CarPlay integration extends Vodia PBX to mobile-first and BYOD environments, addressing hybrid workforce connectivity edge cases.

rows.headline: SkySwitch launches native AI agent for white-label partners
rows.sowhat: SkySwitch brings enterprise-grade AI voice capabilities to white-label UCaaS partners, potentially lowering the barrier to AI-enabled communications for smaller resellers.

rows.headline: Nvidia acquires Hugging Face for $12.93 billion
rows.sowhat: Nvidia's largest software bet yet validates open-weight models and signals a strategic pivot toward commoditizing AI tooling underneath its chip dominance.

rows.headline: Genesys pitches agentic orchestration at Xperience 2026
rows.sowhat: Genesys is framing its differentiation around coordinating multiple AI agents rather than standalone automation—a bet that enterprise architectures will demand orchestration layers.

rows.headline: Optimizely launches Virtual Teammates and purpose-built AI models
rows.sowhat: Optimizely's agentic marketing vision is real progress, but enterprise readiness—data quality, governance, integration—remains the harder unsolved problem.

rows.headline: Alchemer launches Iris to automate feedback action
rows.sowhat: Alchemer Iris aims to close the loop between survey data and CX action, addressing a persistent gap where feedback sits unused in siloed tools.

rows.headline: SkySwitch launches native AI agent for white-label UCaaS
rows.sowhat: SkySwitch embedding a native AI agent gives its channel partners a commoditized AI communications capability without custom integration work—a clear margin play.

rows.headline: Workers lose 20 days annually to AI troubleshooting
rows.sowhat: A new report quantifies AI's hidden operational cost—enterprises are spending nearly a month per employee annually debugging tools marketed as productivity accelerators.

days.label: Wed 02 Sep 2026

rows.headline: iPipeline completes Origo acquisition post-CMA approval
rows.sowhat: A US life-insurance platform consolidates UK pensions infrastructure, signalling cross-border vertical integration in financial-services digital plumbing.

rows.headline: Salesforce embeds Claude natively via Anthropic partnership
rows.sowhat: Salesforce is handing its interface layer to Anthropic — a structural concession that raises whether CRM incumbents can defend their engagement surface as LLMs commoditise workflow orchestration.

rows.headline: Genesys 2026 CX report: agentic orchestration tests strategy
rows.sowhat: Genesys positions agentic orchestration as the operational filter separating CX AI pilots from production deployments — a useful framing, but still vendor-authored research with no discrete product move.

rows.headline: Salesforce, Zoom, Microsoft shift from per-seat to outcome pricing
rows.sowhat: All three are experimenting with pricing detached from headcount as AI automates seats — a commercial-model test that rewrites buyer ROI logic and vendor revenue predictability.

rows.headline: Salesforce Winter '27 release extends agentic AI features
rows.sowhat: Salesforce is shipping agents across contact-centre, commerce, and scheduling — early deployments report 13% conversion lifts, suggesting the agent layer is moving from demo to production revenue impact.

rows.headline: Twilio guidance on AI disclosure in customer interactions
rows.sowhat: Twilio is advising on when to disclose AI use — a compliance and trust signal that CPaaS buyers will need to formalise as regulation tightens and customers demand transparency.

rows.headline: Genesys unveils agentic orchestration platform, reports $2.9B ARR
rows.sowhat: Genesys is betting enterprise CX needs governed agent orchestration, not standalone bots—a strategic shift that could define CCaaS architecture if buyers accept the premise.

rows.headline: Capacity closes $54M Series E at $100M ARR
rows.sowhat: St. Louis-based agentic support automation vendor sees enterprise buyers consolidating customer service AI into unified platforms, justifying material late-stage funding.

rows.headline: Alchemer launches Iris, AI-native CX platform consolidation
rows.sowhat: Iris merges Alchemer's scattered AI tools into one system—an acknowledgment that survey vendors now compete on orchestration, not isolated features.

rows.headline: Sprinklr reports Q2 FY2027 results, no material surprises
rows.sowhat: Quarterly earnings with no disclosed strategic pivots—ordinary financial reporting for a CX platform vendor tracking enterprise AI spend.

rows.headline: Zoom adds AI inbox tools for post-holiday catch-up
rows.sowhat: Zoom targets a familiar pain point—email overload after leave—with AI summarization features that incrementally extend collaboration platform value.

rows.headline: RingCentral partners Digital Island for New Zealand agentic voice
rows.sowhat: Regional channel deal brings RingCentral's agentic voice AI to New Zealand SMBs—ordinary geographic expansion through a local partner.

rows.headline: Flamingo raises $4.5M to automate MSP workflows with agents
rows.sowhat: Seed-stage funding to deploy AI agents in MSP/MSSP tool orchestration—a narrow but plausible wedge if manual workflow overhead proves costly enough.

days.pattern_watch: Agentic orchestration—Genesys, Capacity, and Alchemer all position around governed multi-agent coordination, not standalone AI features.
